text: URGENT CARE PROGRESS NOTE: 32-year-old male presenting with a 4-day history of non-productive cough, mild sore throat, and clear rhinorrhea. Lungs clear to auscultation bilaterally. Vital signs normal, afebrile. Assessment: Acute viral bronchitis. Treatment: Prescribed Azithromycin 250 mg (Z-Pak) 6 tablets for acute bacterial clearance. Patient advised to complete full 5-day antibiotic course.
